name: Complete Passkey Account Registration
summary: The user completes the native passkey ceremony; the server validates the credential and performs the complete new-account bootstrap before showing enrollment confirmation.

preconditions.expression: pending-identity-status == pending and pending-identity-flow == passkey and passkey-creation-challenge == issued

inputs.name: Passkey Credential
inputs.description: Credential response returned by the platform authenticator.

serverInteraction.intent: Validate the WebAuthn challenge, origin, and credential response; prevent duplicate credential binding; create exactly one durable user; create the user's home organization; derive and reserve its namespace from company or personal name; create the owner membership; set home and current organization; bind the passkey; resolve the pending identity; and issue the authenticated session.

postconditions.expression: pending-identity-status == resolved and durable-identity == resolved and credential-proof == passkey-proved and home-workspace == established and workspace-membership == owner and current-workspace == home and session-capability == authenticated-normal

sourceReferences.note: Account and home-organization bootstrap occurs beneath one user-visible passkey ceremony boundary.
